candidates.name: Your property boundaries: overview
verified_facts: The public guidance states that there is usually no record of the exact boundary between two properties.
Most title plans do not show exact boundaries and more precise recording is a separate process.
semantic_limits: Ordinary boundary information cannot be assumed to be exact survey geometry and carries no terrain-height measurement.

candidates.name: Make a boundary agreement with your neighbour
verified_facts: A boundary agreement can record an agreed boundary position or maintenance responsibility between neighbours.
The agreement may use a written description, an Ordnance Survey map or another map to show the agreed boundary.
semantic_limits: An agreement records a legal/consensual boundary position; it does not establish vertical datum, terrain elevation or DTM accuracy.
